title: Webb Captures Stellar Jets
caption: An image from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope released on Oct. 6, 2026, reveals a cauldron of cosmic creation. Webb has unveiled numerous stars formerly hidden by clouds of dust in a stellar nursery known as NGC 7129, which resides about 3,300 light-years from Earth. Learn more about this region – and tour it in an interactive experience.
credit: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI; Image Processing: Alyssa Pagan (STScI)
